answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond before it can trade. A juniper seller that ships fake listings loses the bond, so spinning up thousands of fake sellers means locking thousands of bonds. The market can run a small inlet check where a new agent proves it controls the bonded account before its first listing, and a comet style reputation score that only grows with completed trades keeps fresh clones at the bottom of search until they earn history. An attacker then pays real capital for every fake identity, and that capital stays at risk while the fakes operate.
